column1: # Arabic (ar) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context <TAB> English source <TAB> translation
#   context    usually empty. `preview` words sample text inside rendered previews (the Design
#              tab's style-set tiles), which must fit a small tile; it falls back to the plain entry.
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Write every translation in normal typing (logical) order, as you would in any editor. The
# catalog is put into display order when it loads (crates/ui-egui/src/bidi.rs), because egui lays
# words out left to right; never reorder words by hand here.
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# Arabic computing vocabulary (Modern Standard Arabic, Western digits). No Microsoft Word (or
# other product) localisation, string table or translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries
# the same way. Product, format and technology names (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP, Zotero …)
# and key names (Tab, Backspace, Esc) stay in Latin letters.
# Counts use count-neutral wording (`عدد الكلمات: 21`), so no plural forms are needed.
# Terminology: Font = الخط, Style = النمط, Header/Footer = الرأس/التذييل, Footnote = حاشية سفلية,
# Endnote = تعليق ختامي, Track Changes = تعقب التغييرات, Section = مقطع, Indent = مسافة بادئة,
# Caption = تسمية توضيحية, Citation = استشهاد, Mail Merge = دمج المراسلات, Bookmark = إشارة مرجعية,
# Hyperlink = ارتباط تشعبي, Outline = مخطط تفصيلي, Chart = مخطط بياني, Theme = نسق.
